adjudication.rationale: In the new Salesforce refresh flow, the code directly calls `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and parses the response, but it never uses the newly introduced `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` helper that conditionally routes through `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is set. This means Salesforce token refresh will not honor the credential sync mechanism added in this diff, unlike other integrations updated to use `refreshOAuthTokens`. Also, the plain `fetch` has no explicit timeout/abort handling, so it can hang indefinitely under network issues.
